exposure: Implementation of Enhanced Recovery After Surgery (ERAS) pathway
outcome: Daily oral morphine equivalents (OME) on discharge prescription
cohort: 1473 opioid-naïve patients aged 18+ undergoing cesarean delivery at a large academic center between February 2015 and December 2019
finding: ERAS implementation reduced the overall proportion of patients receiving a discharge opioid prescription after cesarean delivery, but among those who did receive a prescription, ERAS implementation was associated with an increase in the prescribing of daily doses greater than 90 OME.
